title: LLKVApprox prefill
subtitle: Qwen3.8-27B BF16 · 1x CMP 170HX · HF Transformers
verdict: Recorded separate receipt arms at 6,603 tokens: full BF16 3.329 s versus zero-shot suffix 256 at 1.944 s (1.71x). Active quality remains low.
meta: Greedy agreement is not task accuracy
finding: The recorded zero-shot comparison improves prefill speed, but the approximation-active quality diagnostic remains weak after stage 1.
limitation: Timing arms are separate receipts, not interleaved paired trials. Speed and quality use separate cohorts; trained throughput is unverified.
